entries.advice: The last one to pop. Clear the other 54 first — story, stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the money goals — and this lands on its own. There is nothing extra to grind beyond the list itself.
entries.title: Vice Got a Price!

entries.advice: Finish the Gone Fishing mission. It comes early in the story, so play the opening missions in order and it will pop before the wider map opens up. No side work is needed for this one — but it only comes around once, so keep a save from before it.
entries.title: Just Like Paradise

entries.advice: See Chapter 1 through to its end. Keep playing the story missions as they appear and the chapter closes on its own. Save by hand at the start of the chapter in case you ever need to redo a beat.
entries.title: Paradise Lost

entries.advice: Finish Chapter 2. The chapter missions arrive in order, so follow the story markers and this pops when the chapter wraps. Keep a manual save from the chapter start and nothing here can catch you out.
entries.title: T**s Ass Drug Money

entries.advice: Play Chapter 3 to the end. Story missions only — no collectibles or side goals gate this one. Keep a manual save at the chapter start and you are safe.
entries.title: Vice City, Baby!

entries.advice: Complete Chapter 4. Same as the earlier chapters: follow the story, and the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Save at the start of the chapter.
entries.title: Top Of The World, Ma

entries.advice: Finish the final mission. This is the story's last beat, so it only pops once — keep a save from just before the finale in case you want to redo anything tied to it. Everything outside the story stays open after the credits.
entries.title: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

entries.advice: Complete Breakfast Run. This mission opens the partner system, so play the story until it appears and finish it. It is a one-time mission — there is no replay — so keep a save from before it.
entries.title: Trust

entries.advice: Complete The Cartel Heist. A story heist with a single window: play it when the story offers it and finish it in one go. Keep a manual save from before the mission.
entries.title: Break the Bank

entries.advice: Complete Child's Play. Another one-shot story mission — it only comes around once, so save before you start it and see it through. No extra preparation is needed.
entries.title: Family Matters

entries.advice: Complete Headliners. Play the mission when the story brings it up and finish it. One window only, so keep a save from just before it.
entries.title: DWNFALL

entries.advice: Complete VCIA Takedown. A single-window story mission at the airport. Save before it, play it through, and the trophy pops at the end.
entries.title: Hi-Jacked

entries.advice: Complete Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named story missions — one chance, no replay, so keep a save from before it and finish it in one run.
entries.title: Snow Storm

entries.advice: Reach 100% completion. The checklist only appears after the story (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion), but work done earlier still counts: the story itself, 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges, 200 of the 277 vehicle models, all 39 illegal operations, and every collectible set. It is the long grind — save it for last.
entries.title: A Long Road

entries.advice: Land 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all add up, so fold them into normal driving instead of grinding one spot. Keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.
entries.title: Cunning Stunts

entries.advice: Try each of the 9 activity types once. Open the map and sample one of everything — a race, a round at the range, a game at the arcade, and so on. One taste of each is enough; you do not need to win any of them.
entries.blurb: Try each type of activity once.
entries.title: Master of None

entries.advice: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge — 42 across the two ranges. Treat each challenge on its own: learn its target pattern, then run it clean. Golds are per-challenge, so you can retry one without redoing the rest.
entries.blurb: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
entries.title: The Shootist

entries.advice: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at each of the 14 locations. One win per spot is enough. Learn each course's line first, then race it — the win only needs to happen once per location.
entries.blurb: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
entries.title: Top Fun

entries.advice: Win 20 different races. Street races, off-road, air and water all count as long as the race itself is one you have not won before. Mix race types to reach 20 without repeating a course.
entries.title: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

entries.advice: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fish until the challenge appears, then out-fish him. Your fishing skill and the right spot help, but the challenge is a straight contest — keep at it until you win one.
entries.blurb: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
entries.title: Baited My Tackle

entries.advice: Finish one arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts. Pick the one you find easiest and play it to the end — no score target, just a completion.
entries.title: Stick Fiddler

entries.advice: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's strand ends with a single final mission, so finish his strand before the story moves past it. Talk to Andy whenever his strand is available and see it through to the end.
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Andy.
entries.title: Road to Rehabilitation

entries.advice: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand has one finale — play his missions as they open and finish the last one. Keep a save from before the finale in case the strand closes.
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
entries.title: This Was No Boat Accident

entries.advice: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand ends in one final mission. Follow his strand to the end and finish it — the strand does not reopen once it is done.
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Billy.
entries.title: The Lone Rider

entries.advice: Finish 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Only some strands count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's have their own trophies and do not add to this counter. Watch the counter after each strand you finish and keep going until it hits 8.
entries.blurb: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
entries.title: Strangers & Freaks

entries.advice: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand closes with one final mission. Play his missions as they appear and finish the finale before the story moves on.
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Randy.
entries.title: Supply & Demand

entries.advice: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand ends with a single finale. See his strand through to the last mission and finish it.
entries.blurb: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
entries.title: Spin On This!

entries.advice: Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida. Spots show as purple icons when you are close. Meditate with both characters where you can — and do Lucia's Chapter 1 balcony meditation before that chapter ends, because that one disappears.
entries.blurb: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
entries.title: Positive Mental Attitude

entries.advice: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's hunting strand is Jason-only and runs through target decks — take clean head or heart shots to keep each carcass pristine. The strand is one continuous questline, so see it through once it starts.
entries.blurb: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
entries.title: Fair Game

entries.advice: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; collect full sets of three. Track which sets you have finished and keep hunting the missing cards until three sets are complete.
entries.title: Don't Touch My Deck

entries.advice: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Open the WAiNK app and snap spots as you travel — every new location counts. Fold it into normal driving and the hundred will arrive on its own.
entries.title: You WAiNKer!

entries.advice: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges sit under Progress, then Challenges, and many finish on their own as you play. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so push past 50 once this pops.
entries.title: One Last Thing

entries.advice: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Bring your partner, earn four stars, then break line of sight and get out of the search area together. It only pops once you have fully escaped — leaving the flashing zone is not enough.
entries.blurb: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
entries.title: Hot Together

entries.advice: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then hit three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you. If the stars fade, the chain breaks — keep moving and keep the heat on.
entries.blurb: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
entries.title: Retail Therapy

entries.advice: Discover 100 vehicles. Scan traffic with the WAiNK app as you drive — each new model counts. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277, so keep scanning long after this pops.
entries.title: Whip It Good

entries.advice: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 together while aiming. Gather a group of enemies, trigger it, and drop five before it runs out. An assault rifle and Adrenaline help stretch the window.
entries.blurb: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
entries.title: Gunslinger

entries.advice: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work — taxi out and take off. The trophy is delayed: fly about a kilometre from the airport and it pops. Save first; the police come fast.
entries.blurb: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
entries.title: Catch Me If You Can

entries.advice: Get into a Rhino tank — kinda hot in these Rhinos. Tanks sit on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station on Goose Key. Save first, break in, get in the tank and drive and fire until it pops.
entries.title: Challenging Tank

entries.advice: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Yasmani's Chapter 3 job gives you the Snap Gun — use it on a store's locked back door, because kicking it in trips the alarm. Find the safe code note inside, open the safe, and leave unseen. If anyone spots you, reload and try again.
entries.blurb: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
entries.title: Sneakthief

entries.advice: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vault jobs unlock through the optional mission near the end of Chapter 4 — tail an armored van to a big bank and get in while the guard has the vault open. Bring your partner: you cannot carry all the bags alone, and escaping together also feeds Hot Together.
entries.title: Maximum Withdrawal

entries.advice: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Hit an armored truck, grab the take and get clear of the heat. It only pops once you have fully escaped, so keep driving until the Wanted Level is gone.
entries.blurb: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
entries.title: A Classic Blitz Play

entries.advice: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and sail the whole map until every area is uncovered. The map fills in as you go, so fold this into everything else and check the map for the last few gaps.
entries.title: The Goodtime State

entries.advice: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. One operation per gang is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 39. Work through the gangs one at a time and it pops along the way.
entries.blurb: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
entries.title: Pest Control

entries.advice: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Find a bar spot on Ocean Beach with a view and order a cocktail. It is a quiet story moment — just sit, order, and let it pop.
entries.blurb: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
entries.title: In The Beginning…

entries.advice: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Drive a car through a showroom and out the other side. Pick a showroom, build speed, and crash straight through — the trophy pops on the exit.
entries.blurb: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
entries.title: Capital Offense

entries.advice: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Go to the bowling alley and bowl — the follow-through is the moment. Play a frame and the trophy pops.
entries.blurb: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
entries.title: Let's Go Bowling

entries.advice: A partnership with mass appeal — get Jason and Lucia both to maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there; the partner trains alongside you. It takes a while, so train a little every time you pass a gym, and do it before the story closes off easy access.
entries.title: Personal Best

entries.advice: Make 500 choices that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies, fights and other criminal actions all feed the counter, so it fills up through normal play. If it is lagging near the end, keep robbing and fighting until it hits 500.
entries.title: Actions Speak Louder

entries.advice: Second time's the charm. This one is about the second try: fail a mission or activity, then clear it on the retry. It pops when the second attempt succeeds, so a failed run is not wasted — go again right away.
entries.title: Bad Luck, I Guess

entries.advice: What the hell just happened? A one-off strange moment out in the world. When something weird happens, this pops — keep playing and it will find you. It only happens once, so you cannot farm it.
entries.title: The Truth Is Out There

entries.advice: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. Drive past a group and knock them down with a melee attack from the vehicle. Line up the pass, swing as you go by, and the trophy pops when they go down.
entries.blurb: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
entries.title: Ten Pin

entries.advice: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from bank and payday loan jobs — sell them to your contacts and the total is cumulative. Keep laundering until the quarter-million is reached.
entries.blurb: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
entries.title: Dime on the Dollar

entries.advice: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop. Just keep buying — gear, food, clothes, ammo — and it adds up without a dedicated grind.
entries.title: Treat Yo Self

entries.advice: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Buy the eight garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000, and story-given garages do not count.
entries.title: Little Boxes

entries.advice: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app — take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
entries.blurb: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
entries.title: On the Spot

missableNote: A trophy is missable when its description ties it to one named mission, one character's final mission, a partner-only window, or a single story beat. GTA VI has no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start of every chapter and one from just before the finale.
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation list. Guides are original writing built from those descriptions.
